change: Remove evaluation of eight undeclared diagnostic stopping policies. The evaluator now computes only the single preregistered m4-k2-valid-v1 candidate and applies the already frozen one-look gates.
reason: The protocol defines one sole candidate and forbids threshold or policy tuning. Evaluating a nine-policy grid was broader than the written protocol even though only m4-k2 drove the gate.
generation_impact: NONE. The immutable SageMaker generation commit, prompts, model, source IDs, eight-round traces, and launch request are unchanged.
claim_boundary: This is an outcome-exposed development pilot and is not H5 calibration, holdout, certification, or confirmatory evidence.
